step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows a central AWS account using a CloudWatch Events rule to trigger five distinct Lambda functions daily at 07:30 AM. Each Lambda function scans monitored AWS accounts via cross-account IAM role permissions (STS AssumeRole) to identify underutilized resources: EC2 instances, unused EBS volumes (deleting those without a 'preserve' tag), inactive RDS instances (no connections in 7 days), unused ELB load balancers, and S3 bucket metrics/lifecycle policies. DynamoDB stores account configurations and function toggles. Target resources in monitored accounts feed metrics to a local CloudWatch instance.

graph.name: Veolia Multi-Account AWS FinOps Resource Optimizer
graph.notes: Automated serverless solution to detect and clean up unused AWS resources across multi-account environments, saving ~10% annually on AWS spend.
